text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait authorities consider a three-month temporary release from a deportation centre for some foreigners detained prior to expulsion from the Gulf Arab state.
Kuwait deports foreigners suspected of violating national security, people who lack work permits and criminals who have completed prison terms and are awaiting deportation.
- Finance ministers of Gulf Arab states to discuss unified customs fees on Sunday.
- Education ministry launches campaign to combat smoking at schools.
- Fall seen after Kuwait Stock Exchange fever.
